scope: Seventeenth bounded target-specific wave: eight current completion-unproved Finance and Privacy targets; two direct CISO Assistant community benchmark recommendations and six conservative retained-unproved outcomes.

methodology.runtime_boundary: No application, browser, database, deployment or product Git state was changed.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Evidence is behavioural only; do not copy source, schema, UI, wording or distinctive layouts.
methodology.direct_rule: A recommendation requires target-specific neutral job alignment at pinned official community-source loci. Generic adjacency, per-document evidence, field presence or a lower-level primitive remains unproved.
methodology.reuse_rule: Shared repositories do not grant family credit. The two accepted CISO targets use distinct report-computation and export slices; every other reused candidate is explicitly retained unproved.

BIGCAPITAL.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private configuration, commercial offerings and unpinned behavior are excluded.

ERPNEXT.edition_boundary: Pinned official community repository source only; hosted services, private extensions and unpinned behavior are excluded.

CISO_ASSISTANT_COMMUNITY.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only. The enterprise directory and commercially licensed edition are excluded.

DOCUMENSO.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private configuration and unpinned behavior are excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Return governed, interpretable financial insights through the API rather than only generic dashboard bootstrap metadata.
evaluations.research_candidate: bigcapitalhq/bigcapital Dashboard service and controller at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The inspected source returns dashboard aggregate/bootstrap values and guarded metadata but does not prove a separately owned financial-insight lifecycle, interpretation contract or Site-aware API target. Generic adjacency is insufficient.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Compute and return explicitly defined financial KPIs through a governed API with measure semantics and authorization.
evaluations.research_candidate: bigcapitalhq/bigcapital Dashboard service and controller at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The same generic dashboard aggregates do not establish a distinct KPI computation/definition target. The reused source receives no field- or family-level inherited credit.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Convert an accepted quote into the canonical agreement/contract lifecycle with preserved provenance and replay rules.
evaluations.research_candidate: erpnext/erpnext quotation mapping at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The pinned ERPNext mapping proves quotation to sales order/invoice only and is already valid for CAP-FIN-QUOTE-INVOICE-CONVERSION. It does not create an agreement contract, so reuse is explicitly rejected.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Govern breach notification and response dispatch with accountable actor, recipient/authority, idempotency, retry and durable outcome evidence.
evaluations.research_candidate: intuitem/ciso-assistant-community breach model and CRUD view at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The source records breach classification, notification dates/references, remediation and evidence, but the generic CRUD view does not prove authoritative notification/send/retry workflow ownership.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Compute an authorized privacy-compliance report from bounded processing, recipient, request, breach and legal-basis data.
evaluations.research_candidate: intuitem/ciso-assistant-community privacy aggregation at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The role-scoped privacy aggregation calculates processing, recipient, request and breach metrics and produces data-category to processing to legal-basis graph/report data. This directly benchmarks the neutral authorized compliance-report job without importing implementation or UI.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Export an authorized privacy-compliance report with stable fields, safe cell handling and bounded output formats.
evaluations.research_candidate: intuitem/ciso-assistant-community processing export and shared ExportMixin at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The processing-activity export exposes status, assignee and DPIA fields while the shared exporter applies accessible-object filtering, CSV/XLSX output and formula-safe handling. This is a distinct direct export benchmark, not inherited report credit.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Review the system-wide audit log with bounded authorization, filters, event semantics and safe pagination.
evaluations.research_candidate: documenso/documenso document audit-log query and table at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Documenso proves authorized paginated review of one document's audit log, not a system-wide audit-log review. Object-specific evidence cannot inherit system-audit scope.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Export the authorized system-wide audit log with bounded filters, provenance and safe output semantics.
evaluations.research_candidate: documenso/documenso document audit download at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The authorized export is per-document audit evidence, not a system audit export. The difference in object cardinality and authority is material, so no credit is granted.
